text:
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-4721 fired — SOURCE=metrics-alert, symptom=latency-p99, service=inference-rt, region=eu-west. Trigger: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Paging oncall group.

deploy-bot: Deploy rl-9912 started ~12m ago for inference-rt (version=v2-quant). No rollout errors reported.

Jess (Oncall): acked PDR-4721. I'm booting this thread — assigning triage. I'm taking lead.

Alex (SRE): grabbing dashboards now — p95 jumped ~400ms -> ~1.1s, p99 spike to ~2.3s. Error rate steady. Spikes look correlated to kv-cache evictions and sidecar CPU saturation on pod set euw-rt-1.*

Miguel (Infra): seeing host-side queueing on GPUs, sidecar containers showing high RSS and a few OOMKilled events in last 20m. Kube events: CrashLoopBackOff x3 for sidecar on pod inference-rt-5. Might be a memory leak in sidecar v1.4.

Jess (Oncall): good catch. Is this tied to rl-9912 rollout? deploy-bot shows rl-9912 started 12m ago which lines up.

Miguel (Infra): possible. Rolling restarts started but didn't complete. I'm going to scale replicas and restart sidecars on affected pods.

Jess (Oncall): running scale now:```bash
kubectl scale deploy inference-rt --replicas=6 -n redwood-prod-eu-west
```

Miguel (Infra): applied scale + sidecar restart to pods inference-rt-{3,4,5}. New pods coming up; sidecar restarts in progress. Observability: queue depth dropping on node euw-1.

Alex (SRE): correlating traces — a subset of long tails originates from requests that hit a specific tokenizer shard, and we see KV cache miss rates spike concurrently. Suggest enabling prefix KV warmup and route some traffic away while we stabilize.

Nora (Platform): routing change: split traffic 70/30 to eu-west/model:v2 and eu-central/model:v1-quant (fallback) for 10m. Doing a canary failover to reduce pressure.

Jess (Oncall): executed traffic split. Command:```json
{"route":"inference-rt","weights":{"euw-v2":70,"euc-v1q":30}}
```

Miguel (Infra): new pods ready 45s ago, sidecar OOMs stopped. Heapdump started on one affected sidecar for postmortem. Will upload artifacts to the incident ticket.

Alex (SRE): after scale + routing, p99 trending down: 2.3s -> ~1.1s -> current ~870ms. p95 back to ~300ms. Still monitoring.

Jess (Oncall): customer impact: Support logs show two large customers reported intermittent slow responses in the last 25m; no errors, just latency. Notified account leads.

Nora (Platform): Opening an Eng-Infra escalation for sidecar memleak hypothesis and linking heap dump — tagging @Miguel.

Miguel (Infra): running quick grep on heapdump — suspicious retained objects in request-queue component. Will follow up with a focused patch if confirmed.

Alex (SRE): to reduce noise I'm going to mute the ongoing alert for 10m while mitigation completes: `/pagerduty mute PDR-4721 10m` — doing now.

pd-bot: Incident PDR-4721 acknowledged by Jess (Oncall) at 7081234599. Suppression/mute in effect for 10m. Escalation: Eng-Infra added.

Jess (Oncall): preparing handoff notes for night oncall in ~35m. Summary: 1) p99 spike caused by sidecar memory pressure coincident with a recent rollout (rl-9912). 2) Immediate mitigations: scaled inference-rt to 6 replicas, restarted sidecars, routed 30% traffic to eu-central fallback, enabled temporary mute. 3) Next actions: Eng-Infra to analyse heap dump and hotfix sidecar; Platform to monitor rollouts and consider pinning to previous sidecar version if confirmed.

Nora (Platform): pushing a temporary rule to block further autodeloy of sidecar v1.4 until we confirm fix.

Miguel (Infra): uploading heapdump link — https://artifacts.redwood/incidents/PDR-4721/heapdump-2026-03-15-7081235.tar.gz. Initial grep results attached.

Alex (SRE): monitoring metrics — p99 continues to trend down to ~650ms, p95 ~220ms. Will keep an eye and annotate key timestamps for postmortem.

Jess (Oncall): handing off to night oncall @Nora in 35m. I'll post a short checklist and contact list in 15m. If p99 rises above 1.2s again, re-open pager immediately. :thumbsup:

Nora (Platform): acknowledged. I'll take lead after handoff and coordinate the Eng-Infra fix + rollback if necessary. Leaving a reminder to update the incident ticket with impact and customer contacts.

Alex (SRE): quick commands used during triage (for the record):```bash
# scale
kubectl scale deploy inference-rt --replicas=6 -n redwood-prod-eu-west
# traffic split
platformctl route update inference-rt --weights euw-v2=70,euc-v1q=30
# mute
/pagerduty mute PDR-4721 10m
```

Jess (Oncall): thanks team. tagging this thread as incident-handled-for-now but will keep it open until Eng-Infra confirms root cause. :white_check_mark:
